title: Deciphering Hate: Identifying Hateful Memes and Their Targets
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (BHM dataset) that includes the task of identifying social entities targeted by hateful memes. One of the core target categories is 'Targeted Community', which is explicitly defined as hate directed towards groups based on their 'beliefs or ideology towards any religion.' The paper includes religious affiliation as a primary factor in its evaluation and benchmarking of hate speech detection.
